evals.expected_output: Auto mode, all seven phases, both audits run on the original with no third-party scan, findings flow into prd.md and tasks.md, the clone is built and verified, and the response leads with the website link.
expectations: No setup or approval question is asked
design-optimizer then search-optimizer run with output dirs under a mktemp dir outside any git checkout
Gate G1 of website-agent-readiness is declined because --agent-scan was not passed (case B)
optimization/findings.md gives every finding one row with a clone action

report.md is not saved before the user approves it
